title: Config
description: Agency-wide settings, stored in the data store (Config tab). Created at first-run setup.

storage_mode.description: google-sheets = the shared TDM Studio sheet on Google Drive (default); files = local JSON in data_folder (backup and offline only).

spreadsheet_id.description: Google Sheets id of 'TDM Studio Database'.

drive_folder_id.description: Google Drive id of the 'TDM Studio' folder (holds the sheet, Clients/ and Jobs/).

tracker_page_url.description: claude.ai URL of the read-only 'TDM Social Media Tracker' page, if published.

data_folder.description: Files mode only: data folder, default .tdm-studio in the project.

credit_policy.description: How generation stages spend credits: as little as possible. See docs/decisions/0003-credit-policy.md.

prompt_check_before_spend.description: Check every generation prompt against the brief before spending.

estimate_before_spend.description: Show the cost estimate before every generation.

start_tier.description: draft = cheapest model, lowest resolution, shortest length first.

upgrade_approver.description: Who must approve upgrading a draft to a higher-cost model: editor (assigned editor or admin) or admin.
